note: USACE campground at the toe of Gavins Point Dam on the west shore of Lake Yankton, the ~250-acre lake below the dam (Lewis and Clark Lake lies behind the dam embankment, out of sight). 77 50-amp electric sites in two wooded loops; a row of pull-throughs along the open, mowed lake edge. Two shower houses; dump station just north off Toe Road; adjacent day-use area with boat ramp and fishing dock. --Claude
summary: Recreation.gov confirms 77 50-amp sites, showers and a dump nearby. The current rate table is $24 standard and $26 prime, so the stored $20 changes to 24-26. Season is mid-April to mid-October. Weekends need 2 nights and holiday weekends 3. Sites plotted from rec.gov: the east-edge pull-throughs (02P-09P in the north loop, 53P-66P in the south) sit 15-30 m from Lake Yankton across open mowed grass, with no road or day use between. Lakefront is confirmed, on Lake Yankton (~250 acres), not Lewis and Clark Lake. The name needs a human decision.
flags: WATERFRONT CONFIRMED lakefront (on Lake Yankton): rec.gov per-site points on Esri imagery put about 12 pull-throughs (north loop 02P, 04P, 06P, 08P, 09P; south loop 53P, 57P, 59P, 60P, 62P, 64P, 66P) 15-30 m from the shore. The ground between is open mowed grass with scattered single trees; the loop roads run behind (west of) the pads. Lake Yankton is ~250 acres per rec.gov, well over the pond line. Lewis and Clark Lake is behind the dam embankment, so the below-dam rule gives it no value. The 'prime campsites' $26 rate tier matches the lake row.
FEES CHANGED 20 -> 24-26: rec.gov rates 2026 and 2027 are STANDARD ELECTRIC $24 and PRIME CAMPSITES $26. The stored $20 is stale.

NAME: recreation.gov publishes 'COTTONWOOD (NE)'; USACE prose calls it 'Cottonwood Recreation Area'. The stored 'Cottonwood - Lewis and Clark Lake' names the wrong lake: the campground sits on Lake Yankton below the dam. Suggest 'Cottonwood Recreation Area' (or 'Cottonwood - Lake Yankton').

PIN (optional, ~200 m): stored 42.85945,-97.48388 is on the entrance road at the dam-toe road. The centroid of the 77 rec.gov sites is 42.85910,-97.48148. Under the 250 m line, but a move to 42.8591,-97.4815 would put it on the campground.
